summary: GreenPower Motor Company Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the British Columbia Securities Commission's revocation of a cease trade order issued July 6, 2026, due to missed Canadian annual filing deadlines. The CTO did not affect Nasdaq trading; US filings are due by July 31, 2026. No transaction, strategic action, or corporate event is disclosed—only a routine regulatory update. This filing does not constitute a special situation; it is a routine current report of a cease trade order revocation and filing status.
